decision.rationale: Existing sources show drug/modern-machine/extra-content behavior; neither VE nor non-VE delivers unmodified historically appropriate non-drug tea and rice/barley kogashi-yu with the optional tea-only excess-sleep downside. Reuse Vanilla ingestible outcome doer, Hediff severity decay, RestRateMultiplier and cooking; do not introduce chemical drug policy, addiction or new dependencies.
decision.independent_gap: Historical low-tech tea and toasted-rice/barley kogashi-yu in one tiny optional Culture-family child, with ordinary no-buff drinking and excess tea only causing short lived negative sleep recovery; no drug, dependency, tolerance, withdrawal or extra modern items.
